name: Premier Umalas 16 — 3BR Villa for Sale in Umalas, Bali
address: Jalan Umalas Klecung, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara

income.note: August–December 2025 are shown at the average of $2,700 a month.

legal.permits: PBG and SLF issued — the complex is certified for hotel use
legal.owners: Two owners, 50/50; one of them lives in Bali full time
legal.basis: Investment agreement 16U/PDG/XII/2022 of 11 January 2023 and the assignment of rights of 12 November 2025, signed with PT Premier Development Group
legal.documents: The full document pack is shared with a serious buyer on request

afterPurchase: Re-sign with the company running the villa now and carry on without changing anything.
Hand the villa to a different management team on your own terms.
Rent it nightly or monthly and set the rates and the calendar yourself.
Use the villa yourself, full time or between stays of your own guests.
dealSteps: You get the contracts, the payment confirmations and the complex paperwork before anything is signed.
You meet the sellers and the developer in person — one of the owners lives here.
Payment is agreed between the parties: USDT, US dollars or rupiah.
Papers are signed with the developer, who confirms the transfer of rights to the buyer.
description: A ready three-bedroom villa in the quiet lanes of Umalas, built in 2023 and rented out since February 2024 — the buyer takes over a working property, not a construction site. 158 m² of house on a 146 m² plot: three bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and desks, an enclosed air-conditioned living room and kitchen, and glass doors onto a private 4.4 × 2.25 m pool and a planted courtyard. Over the twelve months to July 2026 the villa returned $2,600 a month net to the owners after running costs and the management fee.

name: Villa Black Pool — 4BR Villa for Sale in Sanur, Bali
address: Jl. Kesari II, Sanur, Denpasar Selatan
notes: Transfer taxes are paid by the seller.
7–10 minutes on foot to the main street with shops and restaurants; the beach is a short walk further.
About 35 minutes by car to Ngurah Rai.
description: A four-bedroom villa on a 400 m² plot in a quiet lane on the Sanur beach side, built in 2023 and already in our rental programme. 200 m² of house: a closed, air-conditioned living room and kitchen looking onto the garden, four bedrooms each with its own bathroom, and a 10 × 4 m pool with the greenery around it. Sold furnished, down to the seven air conditioners and the western kitchen. Seven to ten minutes on foot to the main street of Sanur, about thirty-five minutes to the airport.
